author: Arnav
problem: Read N, A, B and N choices C_1..C_N, exactly one of which equals A + B. Print the number (from 1) of that choice.
bug_description: Prints the 0-based index i instead of i + 1.

comments.accurate: Finds the choice equal to A+B and prints its 1-based number
comments.wrong_behavior: Finds the choice equal to A+B and prints its position in the list
comments.wrong_location: Answer numbering verified; check the loop stops after the first match
